vectors.name: a longer term takes the words a shorter one needs
vectors.answer:
Watch the gain reduction.

```terms
Gain: How much a signal is raised.
Gain reduction: How far the Compressor turns the signal down.
```

vectors.name: a shorter term finds its next occurrence after a longer one
vectors.answer:
Set the make-up gain, then the gain.

```terms
Gain: How much a signal is raised.
Make-up gain: Volume added back after the Compressor.
```

vectors.name: a code span is never a term
vectors.answer:
Set `Knee` to 6 dB.

```terms
Knee: How gently the Compressor starts.
```

vectors.name: a code block is never a term
vectors.answer:
Leave it.

```
Knee 6 dB
```

```terms

```

vectors.name: a fenced name that is the whole term
vectors.answer:
Raise «Threshold» a little.

```

vectors.name: a fenced name that only contains the term
vectors.answer:

```

vectors.name: a term behind a list marker
vectors.answer:

```terms

1. Ratio: How hard it turns the signal down.
```
